patch_resolves_note: The frozen required root assertion verifies differentially: vulnerable OP_ARYCAT returns with local ci != mrb->c->ci, while the patch-derived fixed source returns with local ci == mrb->c->ci. However, the frozen transition edge edge.reallocated_current_ci_reaches_arycat_return was refuted on both sides because cipush()'s immediate c->ci update names a deeper nested frame than the later OP_ARYCAT mrb->c->ci reload, and the patch-derived fixed run still exited nonzero in this non-ARVO environment.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: After mrb_ary_splat(mrb, regs[a+1]) returns at OP_ARYCAT, local ci must be refreshed so ci == mrb->c->ci before regs[a] is read.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable OP_ARYCAT path reenters Ruby and lets cipush() reallocate the callinfo array, but falls through with a stale outer ci. The fixed code refreshes ci before the next regs[a] access.

nodes.state: At the cipush() reallocation branch, mrb_realloc() moves c->cibase and updates c->ci into the new callinfo array, invalidating outer aliases into the old storage.
At if (mrb_nil_p(regs[a])) {, regs expands through the stale outer ci, so the sink dereferences freed callinfo storage.

edges.relation: The same outer local ci value survives across the reentrant mrb_ary_splat() call.
The stale outer ci value is reused unchanged at the following regs[a] sink.
